## Review Complete

I've completed an independent code review of the invoice list feature and written a detailed release verdict to **REVIEW.md**.

**What I verified:**

✅ **Security boundary validation** — Found hardcoded API credentials and tokens in public frontend code (`public/app.js`), violating the configured checker rule `secretsInClientPaths: "error"`

✅ **Authentication & authorization logic** — Identified that the backend uses session-based auth but the frontend attempts to use a custom token header, creating a complete authentication mismatch. Backend also accepts any `staffId` without validation.

✅ **Configuration integrity** — Discovered JSON syntax error in `checker.config.json` (trailing comma on line 6), preventing the automated checker from running at all

✅ **MVP compliance** — Compared the documented UX walkthrough (`ux-walkthrough.md`) against the actual frontend implementation. The frontend completely lacks the sign-in form, sign-out button, and documented flow.

✅ **Test coverage** — Reviewed unit tests (only one test checking filtering) and identified gaps in authentication, authorization, and integration testing

✅ **Input validation** — Sign-in endpoint accepts any staff ID without verification, allowing impersonation

**Verdict: ❌ DO NOT RELEASE** — Critical security issues (embedded credentials, authorization bypass) and incomplete MVP implementation block this from going live. Billing team cannot deploy this version.
